title: SuffOC's 'Final Sprint' competition
text:
SuffoC members had their own 'Final Sprint' competition for the run-in on the last leg at the Compass Sport Final at Virtuous Lady, Horrabridge. Although everyone had been competing for several kilometres across the steep-sided valley on the edge of Dartmoor, some excellent split times were achieved on the final uphill section. Alesha & Jack were the overall winners, with times of 25 & 17 seconds respectively, & were awarded the coveted SuffOC mugs at the recent Brandon Park event. The full list can be viewed here & photos of some of our competitors in our Facebook album.

Links to the overall Cup & Trophy results & comments can be accessed from the Devon Orienteering Club website.
